"""Transcribe a media file with faster-whisper (local, CPU).

Usage: python asr.py <media> [--lang zh] [--model large-v3] [--out segments.json]
Prints one line per segment: [start -> end] text
"""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import wave

import numpy as np
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel


def load_audio(path: str, rate: int = 16000) -> "np.ndarray":
    """Decode any media file to mono float32 PCM with ffmpeg."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        wav = f"{tmp}/audio.wav"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", path,
                        "-vn", "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "wav", wav],
                       check=True)
        with wave.open(wav, "rb") as fh:
            frames = fh.readframes(fh.getnframes())
    return np.frombuffer(frames, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("media")
    ap.add_argument("--lang", default=None, help="e.g. zh, en; omit to auto-detect")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default="large-v3")
    ap.add_argument("--compute-type", default="int8")
    ap.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=None, help="also write segments as JSON here")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    model = WhisperModel(args.model, device="cpu", compute_type=args.compute_type,
                         cpu_threads=args.threads)
    segments, info = model.transcribe(load_audio(args.media), language=args.lang,
                                      vad_filter=True, word_timestamps=True)
    print(f"# language={info.language} prob={info.language_probability:.2f} "
          f"duration={info.duration:.1f}s")
    rows = []
    for seg in segments:
        print(f"[{seg.start:7.2f} -> {seg.end:7.2f}] {seg.text.strip()}", flush=True)
        rows.append({
            "start": round(seg.start, 2), "end": round(seg.end, 2),
            "text": seg.text.strip(),
            "words": [{"w": w.word, "s": round(w.start, 2), "e": round(w.end, 2)}
                      for w in (seg.words or [])],
        })
    if args.out:
        with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            json.dump(rows, fh, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

High-end architecture with material-first warmth Design, Build & Live in Harmony Atelier Lumen designs residences, workplaces, and civic spaces where daylight, structure, and craft align.
            From early feasibility to construction oversight, we deliver calm, high-performance environments that age beautifully. Schedule a Discovery Call View Portfolio Carbon-aware specifications Parametric façade studies Site-ready documentation Floating studies — daylight, structure, material

SECTION philosophy ['band-white']
Design Philosophy Material-led sustainability, engineered for delight. Our process pairs editorial clarity with tactile experimentation—mockups, light studies, and iteration cycles that
          translate from concept to construction with minimal friction. 01 Sustainable We treat sustainability as a design constraint that improves the experience: balanced daylight, low-toxicity finishes,
              durable details, and envelope performance that supports comfort across seasons. Passive-first massing and operable shading tuned to climate data and occupancy patterns. Material passports for stone, timber, and metalwork to support circular procurement. Specification sets optimized for longevity: repairable assemblies and robust tolerances. Philosophy Highlights Biophilic principles Low-VOC interiors Daylight autonomy Thermal comfort modeling

02 Innovative Innovation lives in the details: façade rhythm, joinery, and systems coordination that stays legible to stakeholders.
              We use parametric tools and physical mockups to make complexity feel calm. Generative daylight and view studies to refine massing without sacrificing comfort. Constructability reviews with early coordination to reduce RFIs and change orders. Material and color boards grounded in real samples—stone, plaster, bronze, timber. How we prototype 1:50 massing models Facade pattern tests Material palette boards Acoustic zoning

SECTION awards ['band-white']
Awards Recognition for rigor and restraint. A snapshot of recent wins and shortlistings across design excellence, sustainability, and detailing. Drag to explore Detail Journal — Façade Craft Award 2025 • Winner Brushed metalwork and stone reveals engineered for long-term patina with minimal maintenance. Urban Forum — Public Realm Prize 2024 • Shortlist A civic threshold that blends seating, planting, and accessible circulation without visual clutter. Material Index — Circular Spec Challenge 2024 • Winner Material passports and repairable assemblies reducing embodied carbon while elevating tactility. Architecture Review — Emerging Studio 2023 • Nominee Editorial minimalism paired with decisive construction detailing—designed for calm and built for longevity.

SECTION urban-oasis ['band-white']
Project Highlight Urban Oasis Tower A vertical neighborhood with shaded terraces, high-performance glazing, and communal layers tuned for daily life. In Development Where skyline presence meets human-scale comfort. Urban Oasis Tower integrates a climate-aware façade with shared amenities: shaded garden decks, a community lounge,

Back to philosophy Process 9 min read Reducing change orders: coordination habits that actually work A field-tested set of review checkpoints—model hygiene, interface details, and how we track decisions to keep teams aligned. Case Studies Outcomes, not just imagery. Filter by sector to see how we balance concept, constraints, and delivery.   <style>
    :root{
      --bg-linen:#F4EFE7;
      --bg-stone:#EFE7DB;
      --paper:#FFFFFF;
      --charcoal:#141414;

      --bronze-1:#D0A66B;

      --bronze-3:#8A5C2C;

      --accent:#D0A66B;
      --focus: rgba(208,166,107,.35);

      --container: 1180px;

      --ease: cubic-bezier(.2,.85,.2,1);
      --ease-soft: cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1);
      --speed: 260ms;

    *{box-sizing:border-box}
    html,body{height:100%}
    body{
      margin:0;
      font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
      color: var(--charcoal);

        radial-gradient(1100px 700px at 25% -10%, rgba(208,166,107,.16), transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(900px 700px at 95% 15%, rgba(20,20,20,.06), transparent 55%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-stone) 0%, var(--bg-linen) 40%, #fff 120%);

      position:sticky;
      top:14px;
      z-index:50;

      align-items:center;
      justify-content:space-between;
      gap:14px;
